title: fundeth
tagline: Tokenized basket of tokens. Percentage of the tokens that are in the basket are changeable by the vault creator.
description: Fundeth project is a decentralized finance (DeFi) application that provides a mechanism for users to deposit funds in a vault, which are then used to purchase a basket of specified tokens. The purchased tokens are held within the vault, and users receive vault tokens representing their share of ownership in the underlying assets.
how_its_made: smart contracts are done used foundry. dependencies for the contracts are uniswap and openzeppelin. frontend made with react. dependencies for the front end are wagmi, ethers, rainbow wallet, chakra ui. Yeah its pretty much it. Also its made with love of course. Next steps are making frontend better, adding functionality to create vaults that can also hold nfts and price them accordingly.
